Create an ORIGINAL game item sprite for the D'thorga lithium house battery: a modern lithium battery for a camping vehicle, with its isolator. No people, text, letters, numbers, plus or minus signs, logos, brand marks, dials, screens, lights, sparks or shadow beyond the object.
